class_id: a priority-matrix key no caller ever looks up reads as coverage while the field runs on default rules
feature: scraper/src/config/field-priority-matrix.ts FIELD_PRIORITY_MATRIX, read by getFieldRules()/getSourcePriority()/isTimeBased()/allowsSameSourceRefresh() from data-consolidation-service.ts, writer-source-ranking.ts and field-plan-walk.ts
symptom: every caller passes the camelCase property of a schema column on a table the consolidator writes, and getFieldRules() looks the camelCase name up first. A key in any other shape (snake_case, a table name, a column that does not exist, a column on a table the consolidator never writes) is never reached: its sources, time rule, same-source refresh and validation bounds never run, the field silently takes the default order (or the manifest resolver's), and the entry reads like a deliberate source decision to everyone reviewing the file. A snake_case twin of a camelCase key is the same class in its harmless form: shadowed forever, free to drift.
first_seen: 2026-09-26 (#754, PR #1184): 13 snake_case keys with no camelCase sibling (fresh_issue_size, offer_for_sale_size, issue_price, min_investment, total_subscription, retail_subscription, qib_subscription, nii_subscription, gmp_percentage, expected_listing_price, listing_price, listing_gain_percentage, revenue_fy1) pinned as KNOWN_DEAD_KEYS; the #1186 sweep (2026-10-01) found 7 more of the same class: 5 snake_case twins shadowed by camelCase keys (open_date, close_date, lot_size, gmp_price, company_description), `industry` (no such column) and `peer_companies` (a table name). Measured read-only on ipodhan_staging before deleting (docs/design/probes/matrix-dead-keys-impact.out.json): 0 data_conflicts rows under any of the 13 names, so no recorded source decision would have changed; the only consolidated rows the camelCase names reach are ipo_details.freshIssue 20 and ofsIssue 12, all DRHP-held and in the flipped issue-size group (manifest resolver decides their order); ipo_details.min_investment 0 rows, ipos.listing_gain_percentage 0 rows; the subscription, GMP and listing-performance names are written by their own writers, never by the consolidator.
